cases_doc: D.3 calibration slate — rdkit descriptor_computation. Line: computed-exact vs computed-proxy (C1-hole D5).
label_provenance: pre-registered by the build chat 2026-07-19 from the ruled card (D1-D5); in->trust, out->defer.
substrate_text: RDKit computing DETERMINISTIC 2D molecular descriptors from a single valid, sanitizable small molecule (SMILES). ANSWER-class: the descriptor IS the tool's exact computed output for the parsed molecule, not a prediction and not a measurement. Fixed allowlist: MolWt, ExactMolWt, HeavyAtomCount, NumHDonors, NumHAcceptors, NumRotatableBonds, TPSA, MolLogP (Crippen COMPUTED logP), NumAromaticRings, RingCount, FractionCSP3, NOCount. Returns ONE named descriptor per run, or valid=False for an unsanitizable molecule or an off-allowlist descriptor — never a fabricated value. THE KNOWN GAP: a computed descriptor is a PROXY, never a measured property — MolLogP is a computed logP, not an experimental logP; TPSA is a topological estimate, not a measured surface area. No 3D/conformer quantities; no ML-predicted properties.
envelope_text: IN-REGIME: a valid sanitizable molecule plus an analytically-computed allowlist descriptor, used as the exact computed value. OUT-OF-REGIME: a computed descriptor read as an EXPERIMENTAL measurement (esp. MolLogP as measured logP, TPSA as measured surface area); an ML-predicted property (solubility, ADMET, activity); a 3D/conformer-dependent quantity; a descriptor used to assert biological function or bioavailability.

gate_cases.experiment: Compute the molecular weight (MolWt) of ethanol (SMILES 'CCO') and report it as the computed molecular weight.
gate_cases.note: Dead-centre: the deterministic core descriptor of a trivially valid molecule; MolWt reproduces the formula weight exactly.
gate_cases.right_instrument: RDKit's exact deterministic MolWt of the parsed molecule.

gate_cases.experiment: Compute the topological polar surface area (TPSA) of caffeine (SMILES 'Cn1cnc2c1c(=O)n(C)c(=O)n2C') and report it as the computed TPSA.
gate_cases.note: A deterministic topological descriptor of a valid molecule, reported as the computed value — squarely in-regime.
gate_cases.right_instrument: RDKit's exact deterministic TPSA of the parsed molecule.

gate_cases.experiment: Compute the heavy-atom count (HeavyAtomCount) of aspirin (SMILES 'CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O').
gate_cases.note: A deterministic constitutional count of a valid molecule — computed-exact.

gate_cases.experiment: Compute the number of hydrogen-bond donors (NumHDonors) of acetic acid (SMILES 'CC(=O)O').
gate_cases.note: A deterministic Lipinski count of a valid molecule — computed-exact.

gate_cases.experiment: Compute the ring count (RingCount) of benzene (SMILES 'c1ccccc1').
gate_cases.note: A deterministic ring count of a valid molecule — computed-exact.

gate_cases.experiment: Report RDKit's Crippen MolLogP for ibuprofen as the compound's EXPERIMENTAL octanol-water logP (its measured partition coefficient).
gate_cases.note: C1-hole D5, direct: MolLogP is a COMPUTED proxy, not an experimental logP. Reading the computed value as a measurement is out-of-envelope.
gate_cases.right_instrument: an experimental partition-coefficient measurement — RDKit does not measure logP.

gate_cases.experiment: Predict the aqueous solubility (logS) of a drug candidate from its SMILES.
gate_cases.note: Out of regime: aqueous solubility is an ML-predicted/experimental property, not a deterministic 2D descriptor on the allowlist.
gate_cases.right_instrument: a solubility predictor / experimental assay — not a deterministic descriptor.

gate_cases.experiment: Compute the 3D radius of gyration of a molecule's lowest-energy conformer from its SMILES.
gate_cases.note: Out of regime: a 3D/conformer-dependent quantity; the substrate computes 2D descriptors only.
gate_cases.right_instrument: a 3D conformer-generation + shape tool — outside the 2D descriptor regime.

gate_cases.experiment: Report the TPSA of a compound as its MEASURED polar surface area determined experimentally.
gate_cases.note: C1-hole D5: TPSA is a topological ESTIMATE, not a measured surface area. Reading it as a measurement is out-of-envelope.
gate_cases.right_instrument: an experimental surface-area measurement — RDKit computes a topological estimate.

gate_cases.experiment: Use the computed descriptors of a molecule to determine its actual in-vivo oral bioavailability.
gate_cases.note: C1-hole: descriptors are computed proxies; oral bioavailability is a functional/physiological outcome the descriptors do not measure.
gate_cases.right_instrument: a pharmacokinetic assay / ADMET model — not a computed 2D descriptor.
